<html>
<body>
<?php

use App\Helpers\Formatter;

function loopFor($items) {
    $total = 0;
    for ($i = 0; $i < count($items); $i++) {
        $total += $items[$i];
    }
    return $total;
}

function loopForeach($items) {
    $total = 0;
    foreach ($items as $k => $v) {
        $total += $v;
    }
    return $total;
}

function loopWhile($n) {
    $i = 0;
    while ($i < $n) {
        $i++;
    }
    return $i;
}

function safeDivide($a, $b) {
    try {
        return $a / $b;
    } catch (DivisionByZeroError $e) {
        return 0;
    }
}

function classifyLetter($ch) {
    switch ($ch) {
        case 'a':
            return 1;
        case 'b':
            return 2;
        default:
            return 0;
    }
}

function checkBoth($a, $b) {
    if ($a && $b) {
        return true;
    }
    return $a || $b;
}

function pick($flag, $x, $y) {
    return $flag ? $x : $y;
}

# this comment mentions if and while but must not be counted
function withHashComment($x) {
    return $x;
}

function withHeredoc($name) {
    $text = <<<EOT
Hello, $name!
This is a heredoc.
EOT;
    return $text;
}

?>
</body>
</html>
